purpose: 013-V01/V02/V03/V04 listing, details and selected-other-session confirmation/result copy proposal. Requires independent effective server publication; no runtime import, device/trust policy or Product acceptance is selected.

content.account.sessions.revoke.actionHelp: Sign out of this session to end its access to Tunner. You may be asked to verify your identity.
content.account.sessions.revoke.inactiveHelp: This session no longer has access to Tunner. No sign-out action is needed.
content.account.sessions.revoke.confirm.title: Sign out this session?
content.account.sessions.revoke.confirm.descript: This session will lose access to your Tunner account immediately.
content.account.sessions.revoke.success.title: Session signed out
content.account.sessions.revoke.success.descript: This session can no longer access Tunner.
content.account.sessions.revoke.unknown.title: Sign-out is not confirmed
content.account.sessions.revoke.unknown.descript: We could not confirm the result. Check the status of this request before trying again.
content.account.sessions.revoke.unknown.help: Checking this request does not send a new sign-out request.
content.account.sessions.revoke.changed.title: This session has changed
content.account.sessions.revoke.changed.descript: Review its latest details before deciding whether to sign it out. No sign-out is confirmed by this message.
content.account.sessions.title: Sessions & devices
content.account.sessions.description: Review your Tunner sessions and their access status.
content.account.sessions.label: Session …{reference}
content.account.sessions.currentHelp: To leave this session, use the usual Sign out option in your Account menu.
content.account.sessions.unavailableDescription: Session references, times and access status. Device names, location and device trust are unavailable here.
content.account.sessions.collectionDescription: These are the sessions loaded so far. More may be available.
content.account.sessions.allLoaded: No more sessions in this response.
content.account.sessions.referenceHelp: A session reference helps you tell entries apart. It does not identify a device or location.
content.account.sessions.accessDescription: Status is checked when the information is read. A session shown as active may change before you take action.
content.account.sessions.savedStatusHelp: The saved status can say “Active” after a session has expired. Open its details to see both.
content.account.sessions.productBoundary: Session status here describes access to Tunner. Access inside connected Products is managed separately.
content.account.sessions.securityHeading: Need to review your Account’s security?
content.account.sessions.securityDescription: Use Security to review your sign-in and recovery options.
content.account.sessions.currentActionHelp: You are using this session now. To leave it, use the usual Sign out option in your Account menu.
content.account.sessions.otherActionHelp: You can review this session’s access here. Signing out another session is not available on this page yet.
content.account.sessions.signOutUnknown: We could not confirm whether you signed out. Check your sign-in status before trying again.
content.account.sessions.error: We could not refresh this information. Try loading the page again.
content.account.sessions.changed: This session list has changed or its continuation is no longer available. Refresh the list to continue.
